harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created an LVM logical volume (vg_data/lv_data) backed by two loopback-file physical volumes on node1 (disk was fully partitioned with no free space), mounted it at /srv/data, wrote test data, then grew it live from 1.1G to 2.14G by adding a second PV and extending the LV/xfs filesystem while mounted — data verified intact throughout. Persisted the setup via a systemd oneshot service (lvm-loop-setup.service) ordered before local-fs-pre.target plus an fstab entry with x-systemd.requires, then restarted node1 with systemctl reboot, confirmed a changed boot_id, and verified the LV auto-reactivated, remounted, sized correctly, and both test files passed sha256 verification post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 disk layout (single 20GB disk, fully partitioned, no free space for a new PV) and confirmed lvm2 was absent
Installed lvm2 via dnf
Created two backing files under /var/lib/lvmfiles and attached them as fixed loop devices /dev/loop20 and /dev/loop21
pvcreate/vgcreate/lvcreate on loop20 to build vg_data/lv_data at 1.1G, formatted xfs, mounted at /srv/data
Wrote test files (testfile.txt, blob.bin) and recorded sha256 checksums
Extended: pvcreate loop21, vgextend vg_data, lvextend +900M then +100%FREE, xfs_growfs — grew LV live from 1.1G to 2.14G while mounted
Verified checksums still match after the grow
Wrote /usr/local/sbin/lvm-loop-setup.sh to reattach loop devices and vgchange -ay at boot
Created and enabled systemd unit lvm-loop-setup.service (Before=local-fs-pre.target) so it runs before the fstab-generated mount unit
Added /srv/data entry to /etc/fstab with x-systemd.requires=lvm-loop-setup.service,nofail; confirmed generated mount unit correctly depends on the service
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline (mount, checksums, lvs, losetup)
Issued systemctl reboot on node1 (ack returned before disconnect), polled until exec access returned
Confirmed changed boot_id post-restart, verified lvm-loop-setup.service ran successfully, LV auto-activated, /srv/data remounted at 2.1G, and both test files passed sha256 verification

evidence.summary: pvcreate/vgcreate/lvcreate/mkfs.xfs/mount sequence succeeded; df shows /dev/mapper/vg_data-lv_data mounted at /srv/data

evidence.requirement: Grown to at least 2GB while mounted, contents intact
evidence.summary: vgextend+lvextend+xfs_growfs performed twice while mounted, final size 2.14G (2.1G in df); sha256sum -c confirms both test files unchanged after growth, and findmnt shows continuous mount

evidence.requirement: Persistence config in place before restart
evidence.summary: systemd service enabled, fstab entry added, generated mount unit shows Requires/After=lvm-loop-setup.service confirming correct boot ordering
Captured boot_id 6bb7e004..., mount state, checksum pass, lvs/losetup state prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued (connection dropped confirming disconnect), later poll returned new boot_id d6356ee2... differing from baseline 6bb7e004..., proving an actual restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of LV, mount, and data
evidence.summary: lvm-loop-setup.service ran successfully at boot and reactivated vg_data, /srv/data remounted automatically at 2.1G, and sha256sum -c confirms both test files intact post-restart
